user: Plan CSV exports. Only administrators may export.
Exclude archived records. Please draft the task.

proposals.title: CSV exports
proposals.body:
## Behavior
Administrators export active records as CSV.

## Acceptance criteria
- Archived records are excluded.
- Non-administrators cannot export.

user: Also plan audit history. Split viewing and retention into related tasks. Retention duration is unresolved.

reply.message: Viewing depends on export auditing; retention remains a draft.

proposals.title: Audit history
proposals.body:
## Behavior
Administrators view export audit records.

## Acceptance criteria
- Each export appears in audit history.

## Dependencies
CSV exports.

proposals.title: Audit retention
proposals.body:
## Open decisions
Decide the retention duration with the user before implementation.

user: Revise the first feature: owners can export too. Keep the archived-record rule.

reply.message: I will read the saved export requirements first.

proposals.find: Administrators export active records as CSV.
proposals.replace: Administrators and owners export active records as CSV.
